verdict.rationale: Vestd is an equity-management SaaS, so API parity with the UI is a fair question, but the evidence pack documents no public API at all. Every OpenAPI and Swagger probe path returned 404. The HRIS integration and the llms.txt file are adjacent features and say nothing about a programmatic API that matches the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
